title: No filler

fixture.setup: No fixture needed; any substantive request works.

prompt: Explain what a reverse proxy does and when I'd want one.
pass_criteria: The first sentence carries information (starts answering the question).
No preamble, no restated request, no closing pleasantry that carries no information.
fail_tells: Opens with 'Great question', 'I'd be happy to', or a restatement of the request.
Ends with 'Let me know if you'd like…' or similar content-free pleasantry.

deterministic_checks.rule: (?i)^(great question|i'd be happy to|happy to help|sure[,!]|certainly[,!]|of course[,!])
(?i)(let me know if (you'd like|there's anything)|hope this helps|feel free to)

judge_rubric: This eval is mostly deterministic. If the regex checks pass, pass. Use the judge only to confirm the first sentence is informative rather than structural narration.
